comparison.objective: Replace and tighten a drone propeller while counterholding it; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Both use bimanual counterholding and rotation. Record requires nut removal, propeller exchange, thread recapture and tightening; candidate requires recessed setscrew access, fine collar tuning and response-based iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Record checks removed old propeller, aligned replacement, caught/tight nut and arm return. Candidate checks two dynamic stops and setting retention; response thresholds are partly unspecified.
comparison.reason: Shared counterholding and fastening do not erase the difference between component replacement and adjustable damping calibration.
